'''Oma Tres''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[bartender]] of the [[Spice Runners' Den]] on the [[First Order]]-occupied [[planet]] [[Kijimi]],<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> where he had been mixing drinks for years.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> By [[35 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Tres's appearance}}</ref> he had experienced much discord in his position.<ref name="Oma-DB" /> Observant patrons would notice trinkets Tres had collected over the years displayed behind his bar. He may have disapproved of his clientele's antics, however, he did not interfere, as he just wanted harmony.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> As a bartender, Tres only hoped that the conflict would end, and an era of peace would take its place.<ref name="Oma-DB" />

When noticing the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] wearing a [[Jacket|coat]] as the [[droid]] and his crew entered the [[Babu Frik's workshop|workshop]] of the [[droidsmith]] [[Babu Frik]], Tres shook his head in disapproval while cleaning a cup.<ref name="Episode IX" /> After the event, the First Order abandoned the planet following the activation of [[Protocol 13]],<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> which was then immediately followed by the [[Destruction of Kijimi|destruction]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> by the [[Sith Eternal]] with the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' of the [[Final Order]] [[fleet]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Tres had [[Color|gray]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s and light skin. He wore a blue [[scarf]] and a brown coat, as well as black [[glove]]s and a device covering his right eye.<ref name="Oma-DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oma Tres appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. He was played by veteran composer [[John Williams]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> According to Williams, he initally turned down the role, claiming that it would be "silly" for him to appear in the film. However, when he told his wife, Samantha Winslow, of the idea, she immediately convinced him to play the character, saying that it was "more important than doing the score of the film". On set, the props behind Williams consisted of 51 items specifically chosen to commemorate Williams' other films and his 51 Academy Award nominations.<ref name="Legacy">{{HomeVideoCite|film=9|featurette=The Skywalker Legacy}}</ref> Objects include a whip to represent ''Indiana Jones'', a clothes iron for ''Home Alone'', and a book with Williams' initials in [[Aurebesh]] to represent ''The Book Thief''. "Oma Tres" is an anagram of the word "maestro."
